description: This file defines a TraceLoader class for loading and processing trace data, including handling resources, actions, and metadata within a trace analysis tool. It also includes related utility functions and interface definitions.

classes.name: TraceLoader
classes.description: A class responsible for loading trace data, managing context entries, resources, and trace modernization.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads trace data from a backend, processes trace files, and updates context entries.

methods.name: hasEntry
methods.description: Checks if a specific trace entry exists in the backend.

methods.name: resourceForSha1
methods.description: Retrieves a resource blob by its SHA1 hash, returning a Blob with appropriate content type.

methods.name: storage
methods.description: Returns the SnapshotStorage instance used during trace loading.
